name: Meta Gray-Scott trail gliders
description: From the long Meta Gray-Scott search (#47): a few spots that travel in straight lines, each leaving a fading trail. F is raised slowly and regionally (memory 142k steps), D_a and D_b in narrow imprints (reach ~1) where b has been; a spot's own imprint behind it is what pushes it along. No F_forget. Ran 200k steps. Tint = the D_a field (the trails). Try: seed a few spots with the brush; lengthen Da_mem for longer trails.
